embarrassing experience you've ever had?” Here are five of his favorite responses.

| said, “Nothing much.” Finally, he turned and said, “Do you mind?” He was on his cell phone! |

was So embarrassed! [_]- Susan

| sing all the time. One time, a few years ago, | was singing in the shower when my sister came
into the bathroom and recorded me! Later, we were driving, and my sister put on some music.

[_] It was me! | was really embarrassed and turned bright red. - Becky

| fell asleep in math class once. | closed my eyes for a second, and the next thing | remember is
my teacher's voice. He was asking me a question. When | didn't answer, he walked over to my

desk. He asked the question again. [_]- Alex

My friend's parents had a birthday party for her at their new house last year. They had these
glass doors that went out to the backyard. We were all outside, and | had to use the restroom.
